title: Filters
description: Master ASP.NET Core filters — from the four built-in types (authorization, action, result, exception) to dependency injection, global filters, and execution order.
longDescription: This module teaches you how to use filters to keep your controllers clean and your cross-cutting concerns centralized. You will start by understanding what filters are and how they compare to middleware. You will then explore each of the four built-in filter types — authorization, action, result, and exception — with practical C# examples. The module continues with advanced topics: injecting services into filters using TypeFilter and ServiceFilter, registering global filters, and controlling filter execution order with IOrderedFilter.
whatYouLearn: Understand what filters are and how they differ from middleware
Create and apply authorization, action, result, and exception filters
Use TypeFilter and ServiceFilter to inject services into filters
Configure global filters for application-wide behavior
Control the order of filter execution with IOrderedFilter
